# Triggers whose script is exactly 65,535 bytes, in a dictionary the script makes
# (bgd/bgd.add), in an empty folder with a folder bgd (generated by trigbig.py):
# fixtures/sql/trigbig.json, and the dictionary it leaves, fixtures/sql/trigbig/.
cachecursors 0
ddcreate bgd\bgd.add
stmt
direct CREATE TABLE tg (n INTEGER, s CHAR(10))
direct CREATE TABLE au (m CHAR(10))
# --- AFTER INSERT
direct CREATE TRIGGER big_ai ON tg AFTER INSERT BEGIN INSERT INTO au (m) VALUES ('big_ai'); /*  */ END
direct INSERT INTO tg VALUES (1, 'a')
query SELECT n FROM tg
query SELECT m FROM au
# the trigger is listed and dropped
query SELECT name FROM system.triggers
direct DROP TRIGGER tg.big_ai
direct DELETE FROM tg
direct DELETE FROM au
# --- BEFORE INSERT: is the row written?
direct CREATE TRIGGER big_bi ON tg BEFORE INSERT BEGIN INSERT INTO au (m) VALUES ('big_bi'); /*  */ END
direct INSERT INTO tg VALUES (2, 'b')
query SELECT n FROM tg
query SELECT m FROM au
direct DROP TRIGGER tg.big_bi
direct DELETE FROM tg
# --- BEFORE and AFTER together, and a small one
direct CREATE TRIGGER sm_bi ON tg BEFORE INSERT BEGIN INSERT INTO au (m) VALUES ('sm_bi'); END
direct CREATE TRIGGER big_ai ON tg AFTER INSERT BEGIN INSERT INTO au (m) VALUES ('big_ai'); /*  */ END
direct CREATE TRIGGER sm_ai ON tg AFTER INSERT BEGIN INSERT INTO au (m) VALUES ('sm_ai'); END
direct INSERT INTO tg VALUES (3, 'c')
query SELECT n FROM tg
query SELECT m FROM au
direct DROP TRIGGER tg.big_ai
direct DROP TRIGGER tg.sm_ai
direct DROP TRIGGER tg.sm_bi
direct DELETE FROM tg
direct DELETE FROM au
# --- UPDATE, DELETE and INSTEAD OF
direct INSERT INTO tg VALUES (4, 'd')
direct CREATE TRIGGER big_au ON tg AFTER UPDATE BEGIN INSERT INTO au (m) VALUES ('big_au'); /*  */ END
direct UPDATE tg SET s = 'e'
query SELECT n, s FROM tg
query SELECT m FROM au
direct DROP TRIGGER tg.big_au
direct CREATE TRIGGER big_bd ON tg BEFORE DELETE BEGIN INSERT INTO au (m) VALUES ('big_bd'); /*  */ END
direct DELETE FROM tg
query SELECT n FROM tg
query SELECT m FROM au
direct DROP TRIGGER tg.big_bd
direct CREATE TRIGGER big_id ON tg INSTEAD OF DELETE BEGIN INSERT INTO au (m) VALUES ('big_id'); /*  */ END
direct DELETE FROM tg
query SELECT n FROM tg
query SELECT m FROM au
direct DROP TRIGGER tg.big_id
direct DELETE FROM tg
# --- a trigger of the table that other statements read: SELECT, a drop of the table
direct CREATE TRIGGER big_ai ON tg AFTER INSERT BEGIN INSERT INTO au (m) VALUES ('big_ai'); /*  */ END
query SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tg
direct INSERT INTO tg VALUES (5, 'f') /* fails */
direct INSERT INTO tg VALUES (6, 'g') /* fails again */
query SELECT n FROM tg
# ALTER to a short script: the trigger fires again
direct ALTER TRIGGER big_ai ON tg AFTER INSERT BEGIN INSERT INTO au (m) VALUES ('short'); END
direct INSERT INTO tg VALUES (7, 'h')
query SELECT n FROM tg
query SELECT m FROM au
# ALTER of a short one to 65,535 bytes: fails the same. (One that was made so,
# altered short and then again 65,535, reads back whole: not matched.)
direct DROP TRIGGER tg.big_ai
direct CREATE TRIGGER alt_s ON tg AFTER INSERT BEGIN INSERT INTO au (m) VALUES ('alt_s'); END
direct ALTER TRIGGER alt_s ON tg AFTER INSERT BEGIN INSERT INTO au (m) VALUES ('alt_s'); /*  */ END
direct INSERT INTO tg VALUES (8, 'i')
query SELECT n FROM tg
direct DROP TABLE tg
query SELECT name FROM system.triggers
# the dictionary keeps one, for its files to be compared
direct CREATE TABLE tg2 (n INTEGER)
direct CREATE TRIGGER big_end ON tg2 AFTER DELETE BEGIN INSERT INTO au (m) VALUES ('big_end'); /*  */ END
query SELECT name FROM system.triggers
